messages:
alex kim: FYI i'm planning a dry-run tomorrow 08:00 UTC for a new config flow: staggered cohort fanout + quota-smoothing to reduce cold-surge on model variants. want quick feedback before i post RFC.

maria gonzalez: ok, high level sounds good. how many cohorts and what sizes?

alex kim: thinking 6 cohorts: 0.1%, 0.5%, 2%, 5%, 20%, 72% with 15m ramp steps. quota smoothing = token-rate EWMA over 5m + max-burst 2x. runtime flags: `cohort_fanout_schedule`, `quota_smoothing_window_ms`, `cohort_telemetry_tag`.

jon rao: can we emit per-cohort telemetry? need token burn, request rate, 50/95 latency, and error counts per model variant. we should auto-stop ramp if lat95 > SLO or errors jump > 2x baseline.

tara li: add `telemetry.cohort` tag and a bridge event for the console so we can surface per-cohort tiles. also console should have a one-click pause for the rollout.

kevin ng: note: prefix caching skews token signals. cohorts that hit cached prefixes will look cheap. we should also track req/s + unique-kv-hit-rate and sample cold requests for an accurate health signal.

alex kim: good call. i'll include `cache_hit_ratio` and a cold-sample probe that routes 1% of traffic to cold-paths for health metrics.

maria gonzalez: UX question: dashboard show cumulative % or per-cohort breakdown? ops needs quick status.

jon rao: show both. cumulative for rollout progress, per-cohort for debugging. allow muting cohorts from UI.

tara li: require audit log entries for each cohort activation with operator + commit id. also include link to PR in the log.

alex kim: will update RFC and open PR for runtime: https://git.redwood/team/runtime/pull/433. runtime impl notes in PR description.

kevin ng: preflight checklist proposal:
1) perf test w/ synthetic traffic at peak shapes (50-200 qps per model)
2) verify telemetry emits per-cohort tags and cold-sample metrics
3) console tiles wired + one-click pause + audit log entry visible
4) rollback playbook + automated stop on SLO breach
5) notify customer-success + support before dry-run

maria gonzalez: i'll mock console tiles and send screenshots before dry-run. cumulative progress + small sparkline per cohort.

jon rao: small implementation detail: cohort assignment should be deterministic by user-id hash to avoid rebalancing churn. but allow operator override for targeted tests. flag: `cohort_assignment_hash_seed`.

alex kim: agreed. deterministic sticky assignment + operator override. adding fields to RFC.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: `config-dryrun-staggered-fanout` -> staging at 1766669000 (canary).

kevin ng: also watch KV cache eviction rates during ramp. heavy eviction could hide latency regressions. add `kv_eviction_rate` metric to the dashboard.

tara li: plus add a short playbook snippet in console: "If lat95 > SLO during ramp: click pause -> investigate cohort tiles (latency/error/cache_hit_ratio) -> rollback to previous commit if needed."

alex kim: perfect. i'll update RFC with checklist, playbook, telemetry schema. will ping #customer-success and #support 10m before dry-run. thanks everyone for the quick feedback!
